heading_path: Part 9—Removal of trade mark from Register for nonuse
9.22  Registrar must notify parties of dismissal or discontinuance of opposition
text: If an opposition is dismissed under regulation 9.10 or discontinued, the Registrar must notify the parties of the dismissal or discontinuance.
title: Registrar must notify parties of dismissal or discontinuance of opposition
